detail: Installs a thin GitHub Actions workflow that calls the shared web gate in ForkHorizon/ci-gates: dependency install, tsc --noEmit, ESLint when the repo has a config, knip for dead code and unused dependencies, and jscpd copy-paste detection.

files.contents:
name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: web-quality-gate-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  web-quality-gate:
    uses: ForkHorizon/ci-gates/.github/workflows/web-quality.yml@main
    with:
      runs-on: '{{runner_labels_json}}'
      duplication-threshold: "{{duplication_threshold}}"

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`

The workflow calls the shared gate in `ForkHorizon/ci-gates`, so gate logic updates roll out from that repository automatically. It typechecks the project, runs ESLint when the repo has a config, and blocks dead code (knip) and copy-paste above the configured threshold (jscpd).
summary: Typechecks TS/JS and blocks dead code, unused dependencies, and copy-paste.
title: Web Quality Gate

variables.help: Max allowed duplicated-code percentage before the gate fails.
variables.title: Duplication threshold %
